headline: Approved moving forward with five vocational programs, including veterinary technology and diesel mechanics.
summary: Superintendent Jeremy Ray and CTE Director Paulette Bonneau discussed new programs at the Biddeford Regional Center of Technology, including possible use of The Landing School in Arundel starting fall 2027. A student survey drew 1,876 responses, and 73% picked at least one of the five programs as a top-two choice. Approval lets the district seek state approval and funding but does not guarantee the programs open in fall 2027.
decisions: Approved moving forward with the five proposed vocational programs, passed unanimously.
Approved Aquaculture and Commercial Fishing as a future program, not planned for fall 2027.

decision_evidence.quote: Michele Landry moved to approve moving forward with the five proposed vocational programs. Amy Clearwater seconded. The motion passed unanimously, including Patsy Gendron participating remotely.
Amy Clearwater moved to approve the minutes of October 28, 2026. Emily Henley seconded. All were in favor.
